title: USC Transfer Credit Services: Key Information
text:
COMMUNITY COLLEGE TRANSFER CREDIT
- USC maintains articulation agreements with California Community Colleges, organized by geographic region and by college name.
- Agreements list courses that meet USC General Education categories and other core requirements, USC course equivalents, and all transferable courses.
- "Courses not listed in the agreement may be appropriate for transfer in some instances."
- Community College of the Air Force coursework is not granted credit.

ARTICULATION AGREEMENTS AND HISTORIES
- View agreements: https://darsweb.usc.edu/articagrmt/artic.aspx
- Articulation histories cover transfer coursework USC has accepted in the past from local four-year colleges (CSU and UC campuses). The histories were developed without input from those universities and are for USC students only.
- Transfer Planning Guide: https://darsweb.usc.edu/TPG/

ARTICULATION PETITIONS
- Undergraduates can request a change to how a transfer course is evaluated through the My Academics page in Experience USC (https://experience.usc.edu).
- Deadline: petitions should be started "as soon as possible after matriculation and no later than the end of the first semester of study."
- Late appeal: students who miss the deadline may request one final appeal, which carries a non-refundable $150 late petition fee per class.
- Required documentation: the complete syllabus from the correct term and instructor is required. Other course materials may support the petition but cannot replace the syllabus.
- Processing: typically 10 to 15 business days, which may be longer during busy periods.
- Graduate students should not file articulation petitions.

TRANSCRIPT REQUIREMENTS
- USC policy requires official transcripts for all post-secondary coursework. "All post-secondary transcripts must be submitted regardless of the type of course(s) or the quality of the work."
- Failure to submit them may violate USC's academic integrity policy and can lead to denial of transferred credit.
- Mailed (U.S. or regionally accredited institutions): Registrar's Office, University of Southern California, University Park Campus, 700 Childs Way, John Hubbard Hall 106, Los Angeles, CA 90089-0912.
- Electronic: etrans@usc.edu (USC Office of Admission).
- Non-U.S. institutions without regional accreditation: request a "Detail Report with Course Level Identification" from the International Education Research Foundation (IERF). Do not send transcripts directly to USC.

SUMMER COURSES
- Only summer-term coursework is eligible for transfer. Fall, winter or spring courses are rejected as "out of residence."
- A grade of C- or higher is required, and an official transcript must be sent after summer grades are posted.
- Pre-approval is available through Experience USC or the Pre-Approval Form (arr.usc.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/USC-SummerPreapprovalForm.pdf).

CONTACT
- Phone: 213-740-2311
- Email inquiries: submit through askUSC at https://ask.usc.edu/s/ (use your official USC email and include your USC ID number)
- Contact page: https://arr.usc.edu/contact-us/
